messages:
Sofia Park: Heads-up: Uptown LLM Hangout next Wed 6:30pm. We have a small 8ft booth space, 1 demo laptop, and limited power. Need final speaker lineup, swag counts, and one person to own lead intake. Can we wrap decisions by EOD Tue?

Diego Morales: I can do lead intake. Plan: QR -> short Airtable form -> Zap to send CSV to #sales-demo.

Kelsey Tran: Speaker update: confirmed 3 talks (Redwood product intro, cost-optimization mini-case, community build). One lightning slot open. Asking speakers for 1-sentence blurb + headshot by Tue 11am.

Ravi Patel: Swag inventory: 60 tees (S-XL), 50 travel mugs, 120 stickers. Vendor says courier can do 2pm drop-off day-of. Who's on dock?

LogisticsBot: local_dropoff: request received. Venue dock 2 reserved for Wed 14:00-15:30. Confirm recipient name for handoff.

Vendor-Ship: Noted. We'll palletize tees + mugs separately. Label as "UPTOWN HANGOUT - REDWOOD". Please provide onsite contact and preferred contact number.

Sofia Park: Onsite contact is Mia (events). Mia cell 917-555-0199. Mia will check in at dock at 14:15.

Mia (events): AV note: venue provides Wi-Fi but no wired ethernet. Demo laptop should have hotspot fallback. Only two outlets per side. Bring 1 power strip and a small battery pack.

Diego Morales: I'll bring a portable AP and two power strips. Also can bring spare HDMI cable if needed.

Kelsey Tran: Run-of-show proposal:
```
18:15 doors/ mingle
18:35 Welcome (Sofia) 3 min
18:40 Redwood intro (Kelsey) 10 min
18:52 Cost opt mini-case (Ravi) 8 min
19:02 Lightning slot (open) 5 min
19:10 Networking + demos at booth
```
Speakers: please confirm slide deck + 1-page demo notes by Tue 11am.

Sofia Park: Lead form fields: name, company, email, interest (API/Dedicated/Private), demo request (yes/no), preferred time. Diego please ensure GDPR checkbox for EU folks.

Diego Morales: Will add GDPR consent toggle and utm params. I'll share Airtable link by EOD Tue.

Mia (events): Photographer? We can get a staff photographer for 30 mins (setup + first talks) if someone approves budget. Estimated $150.

Sofia Park: Approve photographer up to $150. Please add to events expense spreadsheet.

Kelsey Tran: Small ask: can we bring a banner (4ft) and a printed backdrop? Venue requires proof of non-flammable material. Mia can confirm.

Mia (events): I'll confirm material certs and upload to venue portal today.

Sofia Park: Final TODOs before EOD Tue:
- speakers confirm slides + headshots (Kelsey)
- Airtable lead form live (Diego)
- vendor drop-off confirmed with recipient (LogisticsBot/Vendor-Ship)
- AV pack + power strips (Diego)
- photographer booked (Mia)
Reply with :thumbsup: if you own the item or note adjustments.

Diego Morales: :thumbsup: owning Airtable + power pack.

Kelsey Tran: :thumbsup: will chase slides/headshots.

Ravi Patel: :thumbsup: swag counts verified. Will bring extra stickers.

Mia (events): :thumbsup: confirming dock arrival and venue paperwork.

Sofia Park: Thanks team — will post final run sheet Wed morning. Ping me for any blockers. :sparkles:
